scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && node scripts/build-runtime.mjs && vite build --config apps/desktop/vite.config.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages tests docs scripts .github electron-builder.cjs README.md README.zh-CN.md CONTRIBUTING.md package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages tests docs scripts .github electron-builder.cjs README.md README.zh-CN.md CONTRIBUTING.md package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --dir --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --mac --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --win --publish never
scripts.package:cli: npm run build && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('release', {recursive:true})" && npm pack --pack-destination release
